data.one_liner: Build tool that compiles Flutter GPU shader bundles via a build hook.
data.what_it_does: Provides a build hook to compile vertex/fragment shader files into a bundled asset for Flutter GPU. It tracks engine and file dependencies and can register the bundle with DataAssets when available.
use_when: You need to include custom GPU shaders in a Flutter app
You want automatic rebuilds of shader bundles on source changes or engine updates
avoid_when: Your app does not use Flutter GPU shaders
You prefer runtime shader compilation instead of build‑time bundling
strengths: Integrates with Flutter's build system via hooks
Tracks engine binary changes to trigger rebuilds
weaknesses: Only handles shader bundling, not general asset management
Requires a manifest file and manual hook setup
Limited to platforms supported by Impeller
data.setup_notes: Add a hook/build.dart script that calls buildShaderBundleJson, create a .shaderbundle.json manifest, and list the generated bundle in pubspec assets or use DataAssets mode.
